item.title: A Weekend MCP-AQL Adapter for MakerPerks
item.description: I put an MCP server in front of a friend's builder-perks directory using MCP-AQL. A weekend project that points at something bigger, a discovery endpoint for application processes of all kinds.

item.title: Concert Porter: The Agents Did Most of This One
item.description: My agents built a tool that carries a Concert Archives history into What I've Heard while I was on a phone call. My whole contribution was four requests.
